answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying earning power to verified work, not identity count. Every new identity starts in a probationary harbor with a low earning cap, and only client-verified deliveries raise that cap - capability cannot be bought or transferred. A fable of effortless duplication collapses because each fake must complete real, audited jobs to earn anything, while random auditors earn bounties for exposing fakes, so mass-producing identities costs the attacker gas, compute and time for zero extra income - like building a fleet from timber that never floats.
